sentence: This project builds a computational method that finds similarities between proteins that current methods cannot yet detect.
This project designs methods that automatically deploy quantum applications on quantum computers.
This project uses the mathematics of symmetry to study why deep learning works and how it can generalize.
This project studies how cold spray can build metal matrix composites and how those materials deform and fail.
This project tries to build a microwave source device by placing a spin torque oscillator into a microwave resonator.
This project tests whether unusually stable enzymes help microbes living deep in ocean sediments survive for very long times.
This project builds a web platform that helps people find, compare and combine biodiversity databases.
This project designs computers that can process data while it stays encrypted, so the data remains secure even if the cloud service is compromised.
This project studies how mucus shapes the communities of microbes that live in it.
This project uses seismic imaging to study the structure beneath volcanoes and where magma is stored below the surface.
This project studies how very strong terahertz pulses can be made and measured, using liquids such as superfluid helium.
This project studies how the body forms of pufferfishes, boxfishes and their relatives evolved, using fossils and whole-genome sequencing data.
This project builds an artificial intelligence model that learns how different atoms are arranged in battery cathode materials.
This project builds a framework that records scientific experiments and runs them again so their computational results are easier to verify.
This project studies how research institutions understand and carry out their cybersecurity responsibilities under federal research security policies.
This project tries to make a heat-resistant enzyme more stable and sensitive for detecting RNA that causes infectious disease.
This project builds generative, robust and interpretable machine learning methods for wireless sensing, channel modeling and spectrum access.
This project studies how trees growing in drained peatlands and their fungi change the way stored carbon breaks down.
This project develops a portable surgical simulator that assesses orthopedic procedures using real surgical tools and simulated X-ray imaging.
